home.title: BetInsight
home.description: Transparent AI forecasts for sports events.
home.disclaimer: 18+. Information only. This is not a call to place bets.

storage.file: Neon is not connected. Settings and logs are stored locally in data/admin-state.json and are not used in production.

login.title: Administrator sign-in
login.description: The panel is private. API keys stay on the server.
login.invalid_credentials: The email or password is wrong.
login.not_configured: ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD and AUTH_SECRET are not set.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Leagues, credit spend and integration status. Public statistics are not changed from here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Leagues, markets, region, value thresholds and the model. Totals ranges are separate for football and basketball.
settings.leaguesDescription: Clear a league to keep it out of odds requests.
settings.marketsDescription: An /odds request costs the number of markets times the number of regions.
settings.regionHint: eu by default, because Pinnacle is quoted there.
settings.thresholdsDescription: A candidate passes when EV is above the threshold, the price is inside the range, and enough books quote it.
settings.modelDescription: Changing the model does not require a code change. Free models ending in :free cannot be saved.
settings.reserveHint: Odds requests stop when they would leave less than the reserve.
settings.testRunsHint: At most one run every 5 minutes. The day resets at 00:00 UTC.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: The Odds API credits and model cost. Test runs are included in the same ledger.

jobs.title: Job log
jobs.description: Only a failed job can be queued again. The message is published to QStash when the scheduler is configured.

settlement.title: Manual settlement
settlement.description: Only events missing from /scores, already started, with an unsettled pick. The comment is required and written to the audit log.

test.title: Chain check
test.description: Odds request, the mathematical model and the AI forecast. Nothing is written to predictions, the public site or Telegram.
test.noLeagues: No leagues are enabled. Turn one on in settings.
test.mocked: Preview or mock mode: The Odds API is not called and no credits are spent.
test.noModelRows: There is nothing to score in these prices.
test.ai_cap: The model is called for at most three events per run.
test.missing_openrouter_key: The OpenRouter key is missing, so the AI block was skipped.

errors.reserve: The request was stopped: it would leave less than the results reserve.
errors.insufficient: There are not enough credits for this request.
errors.odds_range: The lower price bound is above the upper bound.
errors.totals_range: The lower totals bound is above the upper bound.
errors.leagues: At least one league must stay enabled.
errors.free_model: A free model cannot be saved.
errors.unknown_prompt: That prompt version is not in the repository.
errors.interval: The next test can run in 5 minutes.
errors.daily: The daily test-run limit is used up.
errors.missing_odds_key: The Odds API key is not set.
errors.odds_failed: The Odds API did not return a usable response.
errors.not_failed: Only a failed job can be restarted.
errors.scheduler_unconfigured: QStash is not configured, so the job was not queued.
errors.publish_failed: QStash did not accept the message.
errors.not_found: The forecast or event was not found.
errors.not_eligible: The event can still arrive from /scores.
errors.comment: The comment must be 10 to 500 characters.
